title: Independently check #4541's packed RAM transfer: §1 parameters exactly, §2-3 macro steps by a separate packed simulator (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4541-packed-transfer-check/`, an independent check of Dugongue's #4541 (head `46ca24a8`), the packed Word RAM transfer `O((T+n+m)/log(n+2) + (n+2)^(1/16) log(n+2))`. It covers the §1 parameter arithmetic and the macro-step invariant and halting of §§2–3. **All checked claims are confirmed. No new κ.**

The verifier was written from #4541's `PROOF.md` text alone, vendored with its blob `43a6afbe` and SHA256 pinned. Nothing is imported from #4541's code.

## Checks

- **§1, exact integers, 720,240 cases** (`k ≤ 8`, `c ∈ {2,4,8}`, `s ≤ 10`, `λ ≤ 3000`):
  - `16b ≤ λ` above the stated cutoff, so the table has at most `(n+2)^(1/16)` rows;
  - `128Kc·r ≥ λ`;
  - `L ≤ B`;
  - codec exponent `cr < b`;
  - the origin margin `H > 2·2^(a−4)(n+2)^d` (12,288 cases).
- **§§2–3, independent packed simulator.** It implements B-field words with dirty high bits, interleaved tapes, signed coordinates at H, two-word windows with all reads before writes, an r-step local table and the head update `old + local − r`. Against direct execution on **486 random multi-tape machines**:
  - 263 halting runs match exactly on state, count, heads and every cell;
  - 223 nonhalting runs match at every macro boundary;
  - the runs include 46 halts found at an epoch boundary with elapsed zero, and 11,090 block-crossing windows;
  - dirty high bits are preserved;
  - the shifted-writeback rejection control is caught in 19 of 20 runs.
- **Binding.** 9 statements are bound verbatim to the vendored proof.
- **Replay.** #4541's own package replays at its head (`outcome=partial`, 4.3 s).

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4541-packed-transfer-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4541-packed-transfer-check outcome=completed   (~2 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitations:**
- The packed IO codec (§4), the corollary's TM antecedent and the RamStd lowering are out of scope.
- The simulator runs are a finite random family. They corroborate the written universal argument but do not replace it.

Head: `a821e926e3d7eaeae8b12be974dc5083360f6494`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.
